```{python}
# Note that while in Positron, we want to start the same _instance_ of python env.
# Therefore, we run the python code using reticulate using the function: py_run_string()

py_run_string("
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
")
```

```{python}
# Note that while in Positron, we want to start the same _instance_ of python env.
# Therefore, we run the python code using reticulate using the function: py_run_string()

py_run_string("
im = Image.open(
    'C:/Users/ZE18RP/OneDrive - Aalborg Universitet/Skrivebord/courses/medicinsk-statistik/images/gorilla-waving-cartoon-black-white-outline-clipart-914.jpg'
)  # download at https://classroomclipart.com/clipart-view/Clipart/Black_and_White_Clipart/Animals/gorilla-waving-cartoon-black-white-outline-clipart-914_jpg.htm
pixels = np.asarray(im)

# Set threshold level
threshold_level = 50

# Find coordinates of all pixels below threshold
coords = np.column_stack(np.where(pixels < threshold_level))
")
```

```{r}
set.seed(28 - 4 + 2026)

coords <-
  as.data.frame(py$coords) |>
  dplyr::sample_n(1768) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    bmi = V2 * 17 + 15,
    steps = 15000 - V1 * 15000 / max(V1)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    randvar = rnorm(dplyr::n(), mean = 0, sd = 10),
    randi = steps * (1 + randvar),
    gender = dplyr::case_when(randi < median(steps) ~ "Female", TRUE ~ "Male")
  )
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
coords |>
  dplyr::count(gender)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
coords |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = bmi, y = steps)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  ggplot2::theme_void() +
  ggplot2::xlim(0, 15000)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
coords |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = bmi, y = steps, color = gender)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  ggplot2::theme_void() +
  ggplot2::xlim(0, 15000)
```
